methodology.baseline: One real bulk body_q.numpy() before CPU gather/filter; subset intentionally still transfers all Bodies
methodology.candidate: Actual TransformExtractor Warp gather on sim stream, event-ordered pinned copy stream and worker filter; every Future is awaited
methodology.timing: CUDA gather/readback fields are device event durations. Enqueue, host copy/filter, endToEnd and Pipe fields are host wall times. Do not add overlapping clocks.
methodology.scope: Sequential observations measure latency, not solver/readback overlap speedup. No physics step workload is invented here; real Runner command smoke separately proves integration.
methodology.ipc: Actual spawned-process multiprocessing Pipe send_bytes/recv_bytes with the production FrameCodec. Pipe send is blocking-call duration; receiveWaitAndCopy includes producer wait. Roundtrip includes decode, independent oracle and acknowledgement, and is an upper bound, not pure transfer latency.
methodology.limits: Warmup excluded; every sample checked; shared workstation. Full Manifest remains the Runner recovery target; per-observer GPU pushdown is not implemented. Subset byte savings apply only to this explicit subset experiment.
